purpose: Canonical end-of-migration cleanup backlog. Partial ports retain original coverage until replacement evidence or reviewed retirement resolves each gap.

gaps.missing_proof: Real settings API 409 SettingsConflict translation; original manufactures a repository.StaleSettingsError with a private save patch.
gaps.cleanup_action: Find a deterministic real request/revision conflict that exercises the translation, or explicitly review retirement/reclassification of the private-injection oracle.

gaps.missing_proof: Abrupt process-death recovery during import, after import and after source rename. New real SQLite/filesystem exception fixtures prove retry behavior but are not equivalent crash proof.

gaps.missing_proof: Whether root cleanup via dot/dot-slash is intended product behavior. The evaluation contract required rejection, but that contract was not a historical product specification.
gaps.cleanup_action: Resolve product intent, then add the accepted regression behavior and any required fix. Do not promote the evaluation requirement or discard the observed discrepancy implicitly.

gaps.missing_proof: The new plugin declares no hard-hang timeout or descendant-process cleanup guarantee; old runner protections must not disappear silently at cutover.

gaps.cleanup_action: Exercise real concurrent move/edit with stable lifecycle/lock observations or a sanctioned controllable I/O boundary, without claiming sequential results prove waiting.

gaps.missing_proof: Original restore_calls==1 while the first restore was paused is not established by real concurrent submissions yielding one success/one rejection and correct final files.

gaps.resolution: Original deep-copied values now drive matching; only serialized copies and error diagnostics are redacted. Four new package regressions pass, including distinct registered values and mutation isolation. Installed-wheel real-app wrong-value oracle fails as expected.

gaps.missing_proof: The capture projector sanitizes actual application activity/validation/Logfire emission and warning identity before observation. Registered-secret log-absence assertions cannot establish that the application itself sanitized emissions.
gaps.cleanup_action: Resolved by focused regression and negative-control evidence; historical finding and original evidence retained.
gaps.scope_note: The legacy adapter shares this projection hook; this is an application-observation boundary problem, not a reason to revert to the old runner.
gaps.resolution: Projection is confined to exported YAML copies; observation gets independent original values. Two logging cases prove production warning identity, original activity emissions and callback mutation isolation. Deliberately unsafe logging fails the unchanged confidentiality oracle; settings lifecycle and owner-session assertions pass unchanged.

gaps.missing_proof: Shutdown may fail before background tasks or scheduler stop, yet controller clears global runtime and the next fixture admits another app based only on that cleared sentinel. No active leak was reproduced; the failure-path weakness is established by control flow.
gaps.cleanup_action: Resolved by focused regression and negative-control evidence; historical finding and original evidence retained.
gaps.resolution: A sticky controller cleanup failure rejects restart. The app fixture marks the pytest session failed on uncertain fixture release and retains the original error. Real filesystem-induced shutdown failures, including a caught earlier close exception, abort the invocation with exit 2 and leave the next selected application incomplete with no phases. Ordinary cleaned-up startup exceptions continue in the worker; native crashes use xdist replacement.
